A '''battle''' was fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] in [[3963 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] clashed on the planet, and the Republic suffered approximately 2,000 casualties over one night. However, the Republic also acquired [[Neo-Crusader assault armor|Neo-Crusader shock armor]] and began to study them.<ref name="Defense" />
